items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: But anyway, he's been a very dear friend to me, and I hear from him.

ctx.x: Well, that's what they said. But anyway, he's been a very dear friend to me, and I hear from him.

As a matter of fact I got a letter from him today, and he's quite busy, and he's into the record bit, and he's into producing, he's into writing and poetry, and whatever, but he's quite a guy, in Rio de Janeiro, but I'm very grateful to have him as a friend and somebody who is interested in my work. And he tells me, "You've got to come to South America. You've got to come." And someday I would love to go.
